comment: Written against Antigravity CLI 1.4.8 (Homebrew cask antigravity-cli, linked as agy; full-screen TUI on the alternate screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty with a signed-in Google AI Pro account, the sign-in menu from a signed-out one; must be re-verified when Antigravity CLI changes its TUI. The sign-in menu ('Select login method:', '> 1. Google OAuth'), the workspace-trust question ('Do you trust the contents of this project?', '> Yes, I trust this folder', 'No, exit') and the tool approval ('Requesting permission for:', 'Run this command?' — or 'Allow access to this file?' / 'URL?', 'Allow calling this tool?' — with '> 1. Yes, run command' … '4. No, cancel' and the '↑/↓ Navigate · tab Amend' hint) are BLOCKED; Esc cancels the approval and leaves 'Interrupted · What should Antigravity CLI do instead?'. The Braille spinner line ('⡿  Generating...', '⣽  Running command...') and the footer 'esc to cancel' shown while a turn runs are WORKING; the footer '? for shortcuts' is IDLE. The approval dialog also shows the 'esc to cancel' footer, so the approval rule has the higher priority. The first-run setup (colour scheme, 'Terms of Service & Data Use') intentionally matches no rule. agy can also report its state to the terminal over OSC 7501, which korTTY does not read.

anyLineRegex: ^\s*Do you trust the contents of this project\?\s*$
^\s*(?:Run this command|Allow access to this \w+|Allow calling this tool|Do you want to proceed)\?\s*$
